aboutGame.title: What is Deified?
paragraphs: Deified is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelite developed by Unexpected and published by Goblinz Publishing. You collect cursed relics, restore them through a multi-stage deification ritual, manage powerful slots, and build synergies that carry you through run after run.

Each run mixes tactical turn-based combat with permanent between-run progression. You face seven formidable bosses, each carrying a unique curse that can disrupt an otherwise reliable strategy, while skill trees and class ascension reopen your growth curve whenever a base kit plateaus. Deified entered Early Access on April 27, 2026 and reached 1.0 on September 21, 2026.

modules.name: Deified Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core turn-based roguelite loop, relic restoration, slot management, combat rules, and how to approach your first runs without prior knowledge.

highlights.detail: Learn every control and test each action before your first real fight.
Bank your main progression resource instead of spending it on speculative upgrades.
Fund your survival baseline first so you live long enough to learn enemy timing.
Study one boss per session and repeat a single encounter instead of scattering attempts.
Revisit cleared areas, which become efficient resource farms once your build stabilizes.
Reassess your build after every boss before pushing deeper into the run.

modules.name: Deified Relics
modules.description: Cover relic types, fragments, restoration, bonuses, drawbacks, and synergy combinations that decide whether a build clears endgame content.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Relics that grant a brand-new mechanic or resource — deify these first.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Relics that remove a hard cap or cooldown — deify as soon as materials allow.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Large flat or percentage stat boosts — deify after S and A are funded.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Minor utility or convenience effects — skip unless you have surplus materials.

modules.name: Deified Bosses
modules.description: A practical reference for the game's major bosses, including their unique curses and the combat considerations that decide a clear.

highlights.label: Act 1
highlights.detail: Mortal phase — clean combos; learn the punish windows and take no risks.

highlights.label: Act 2
highlights.detail: Ascension phase — a new form and arena changes force a fresh timing chart.

highlights.label: Act 3
highlights.detail: Desperation phase — compressed timings and enrage; punish only guaranteed openings.

highlights.label: Scout
highlights.detail: Spend one attempt observing instead of winning and build a punish chart.

modules.name: Deified Skill Trees
modules.description: Explain skill-tree progression, unlockable options, and how permanent unlocks change the choices available during future runs.

highlights.detail: Start with a job description: decide what your build must do before spending a point.
Invest in survival and consistency layers before expensive synergy pieces.
Budget points in phases and stop at soft caps instead of chasing diminishing returns.
Test each new node in low-risk content before committing to a full respec.
Revisit your tree after every boss, since late unlocks change which paths pay off.

highlights.label: Prep

highlights.label: Relics

highlights.label: Slots

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Deified.

items.question: What is Deified?
items.answer: Deified is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelite developed by Unexpected and published by Goblinz Publishing. You collect cursed relics, restore them through deification, manage powerful slots, and fight seven bosses across repeatable runs.

items.question: Is Deified beginner friendly?
items.answer: Deified has a steep opening, but the Deified beginner guide walks you through controls, combat fundamentals, and early upgrade priorities so your first runs still make progress.

items.question: What are Deified relics and how do you deify them?
items.answer: Deified relics are equippable artifacts with passive bonuses. You attune, consecrate, and ascend a relic before the final deification step grants a unique mythic effect, and the catalyst for that step is usually the real bottleneck.

items.question: Which Deified build should I start with?
items.answer: Start with a survival-focused Bulwark Deity or a flexible Hybrid Ascendant, then move into the Ascendant Striker once you know the boss patterns. Deified rewards consistency over fragile burst early on.

items.question: Are there Deified codes?
items.answer: Yes. Deified codes are time-limited promotional strings that grant free currency, boosts, and cosmetics. Redeem them the day you find them, since most expire without warning.

items.question: How many bosses and achievements does Deified have?
items.answer: Deified features seven bosses, each with a unique curse, and 44 Steam achievements covering boss defeats, progression milestones, exploration, and special objectives.
